title: Georgia warehouses once planned for ICE detention centers now listed for sale after local opposition
summary_full: Plans to transform warehouses in Georgia into immigration detention centres have been officially scrapped following strong backlash from local residents. Concerns raised about public safety and declining property values triggered rapid intervention from elected representatives. The General Services Administration will now proceed to auction off the previously purchased properties. Community leaders are optimistic about fostering beneficial commercial developments instead of the abandoned detention centre initiative.
